notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.0
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

Welcome to the 0.5.0 patch of the demo for our project, Neo Habits!
In this patch, we’ve addressed some bugs we identified and improved the UI for better visualization of hacking and logs.
We're continuing to patch and add content to the demo, so we hope you'll stick with us on this journey of self-discovery, bug fixing, and creating a game you’ll truly enjoy.

XOXO,
Xorcist

notes.title: Neo Habits demo ver 0.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello There!!!

This is the first demo for our project Neo Habits. You may encounter issues during your experience, but we are already working on a new patch to solve most of the issues we have already identified. Additionally, we are adding a better tutorial to showcase all the features that Neo Habits has for you!

I'll be updating this page often, as we have a content patch coming to the demo, so you can expect some surprises.

Last but not least, if you find bugs, crashes, or issues during your experience, let us know here or on our Discord community. ;D

https://discord.gg/h7dmWbmXwp

Stay scared, Neo Habits awaits!!

XOXO,
Xorcist
